Definition
[Directional derivative] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0449 1. apph:H.22\group Directional derivatives For $V\in \T _pS$, define \[ (D_Vf)(p)=\lim _{s\to 0^+}\frac{f(\exp _p(sV))-f(p)}{s} \] when the limit exists. The difference quotient is denoted $J_s(V)$.
